sentence_stem: Years later, when I looked back at those letters,
correct_completion: I finally understood how much my father had sacrificed without ever saying so.
full_sentence: Years later, when I looked back at those letters, I finally understood how much my father had sacrificed without ever saying so.
acceptable_variants: I began to see the quiet sacrifices behind his silence.
his silence suddenly made sense to me.

options.text: the house still smelled of cinnamon.
options.why_wrong: This is a sensory detail, but the stem sets up a reflective moment that needs a realization.

options.text: I threw every one of them away.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the act of looking back at the letters with understanding, so it does not complete the reflective frame.

options.text: I finally understood how much my father had sacrificed without ever saying so.
the post office had closed early that day.
options.why_wrong: This is a logistical detail that does not complete the reflection introduced by the stem.

grammar_focus: Temporal clauses with 'when' and past reflection
explanation: The stem sets up a reflective moment in the past, so the completion must state the insight the writer gained at that time. Learners often add a concrete event where the sentence needs a realization.
translation: Años después, cuando volví a leer aquellas cartas, por fin comprendí cuánto había sacrificado mi padre sin decirlo nunca.
